help:
Usage: prompt [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Prompt management (Agent Hub)

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list
  get
  search
  create
  update
  revisions
  restore
  measure
  delete
  assign
  unassign
  assignments
  export       Export prompt(s) to YAML.
  import       Import prompts from YAML.
help.list:
Usage: prompt list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --global / --no-global  Filter by global flag
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
help.get:
Usage: prompt get [OPTIONS] {slug}

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.search:
Usage: prompt search [OPTIONS] {query}

Arguments:
  query  Literal query to search in prompt metadata and content  [required]

Options:
  --global / --no-global   Filter by global flag
  --case-sensitive         Use case-sensitive matching
  --limit <int range>      Maximum prompts to return  [default: 50; x>=1]
  --max-lines <int range>  Maximum content line hits per prompt  [default: 5;
                           x>=1]
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
help.create:
Usage: prompt create [OPTIONS] {slug} {name}

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug  [required]
  name  Display name  [required]

Options:
  -f, --file <path>        Markdown file path  [required]
  --global / --no-global   Global prompt  [default: no-global]
  -d, --description <str>
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
help.update:
Usage: prompt update [OPTIONS] {slug}

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug  [required]

Options:
  -f, --file <path>        New content file
  -n, --name <str>         New name
  --global / --no-global   Global flag
  --enabled / --disabled   Enabled flag
  -d, --description <str>
  --change-reason <str>    Optional reason recorded in memory revision history
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
help.revisions:
Usage: prompt revisions [OPTIONS] {slug}

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug  [required]

Options:
  -l, --limit <int>  Max revisions to return (1-100)  [default: 20]
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.restore:
Usage: prompt restore [OPTIONS] {slug} {revision_id}

Arguments:
  slug         Prompt slug  [required]
  revision_id  Prompt revision UUID to restore  [required]

Options:
  --change-reason <str>  Optional reason recorded in memory revision history
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
help.measure:
Usage: prompt measure [OPTIONS] {slug}

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug  [required]

Options:
  -f, --file <path>  Candidate content file
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.delete:
Usage: prompt delete [OPTIONS] {slug}

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.assign:
Usage: prompt assign [OPTIONS] {agent} {prompt} {role}

Arguments:
  agent   Agent slug  [required]
  prompt  Prompt slug  [required]
  role    Role (system, guardrail, etc.)  [required]

Options:
  -p, --priority <int>  Priority (lower = first)  [default: 0]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
help.unassign:
Usage: prompt unassign [OPTIONS] {agent} {prompt}

Arguments:
  agent   Agent slug  [required]
  prompt  Prompt slug  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.assignments:
Usage: prompt assignments [OPTIONS] {agent}

Arguments:
  agent  Agent slug  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.export:
Usage: prompt export [OPTIONS] [slug]

  Export prompt(s) to YAML. Use for editing, then re-import.

Arguments:
  slug  Prompt slug (omit for all)

Options:
  -o, --output <path>  Output file
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.import:
Usage: prompt import [OPTIONS] {file}

  Import prompts from YAML. Creates if missing, updates if changed.

Arguments:
  file  YAML file to import  [required]

Options:
  --dry-run  Preview without changes
  --help     Show this message and exit.

usage.cmd: st prompt list | get | update | measure
precautions: run st prompt measure before and after edits
keep prompts in DB; never duplicate as checked-in markdown
goal-first; ordered workflow only when order matters

argv:
import json
from st_sdk.runtime import describe_app
from agent_hub_st.__main__ import OWNED_APPS
print(json.dumps(describe_app(OWNED_APPS['prompt'], 'prompt')))
